baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled passive hudu, each followed by ila, coordinates al-tayyib min al-qawl with sirat al-Hamid as two destinations.
baseline_models.mechanism: Gentle direction first selects wholesome utterance and then places its recipients on a straight course belonging to or terminating in the Praiseworthy.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the repeated directional action governing both complements.
Goodness, purity, and lawfulness make the selected speech morally and affectively sound.
Articulated utterance gives the first destination an audible and relational medium.
The straight road turns the second destination into sustained movement rather than a single saying.
The one rich in praised qualities identifies the route by its praiseworthy owner or goal.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply reports pleasant words and a good road among rewards.
changed_reading.after: The verse depicts two coordinated formations of agency: purified speaking and durable travel on the Praiseworthy's course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Min al-qawl can reach beyond voiced language, while the movement from qawl to sirat can mark a passage from inward assent to lived direction.
baseline_models.mechanism: A willing, uncoerced soul receives wholesome inward speech or belief; the repeated guidance then converts that assent into a settled manner of proceeding toward a praiseworthy end.

activation_trace.role: Direction, intent, and manner let guidance govern an orientation or conduct as well as a road.
The soul becoming pleased without coercion supplies voluntary inward reception.
Speech conceived within before vocalization makes the first guidance interior as well as audible.
Speech as belief gives the wholesome saying a durable cognitive commitment.
The straight road embodies inward assent as a continuing course.
A praiseworthy utmost end gives the inward-to-outward movement its telos.

changed_reading.before: Good speech is only something heard or spoken in the final scene.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can begin as freely accepted inward conviction and become an embodied course toward a praiseworthy end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier h-d-y plus ila construction leads under corrupt patronage to punishment. Its reuse in the focus makes guidance a routing operation whose moral value is supplied by guide and destination; the doubled focus routing reverses the destructive destination into wholesome speech and the Praiseworthy's course.

activation_trace.role: Direction and intent let the same h-d-y plus ila syntax function as routing even when its endpoint is punishment.
Deviation from guidance and purpose marks the corrupt orientation that feeds the punitive route.
Repeated direction now splits the corrected routing across a verbal destination and a traversed destination.
Wholesome purity supplies the positive valence absent from guidance considered by itself.
The richly praiseworthy owner or goal supplies the second route's positive valence.

structural_cues: 22:4 couples a misleading patron's causing error with guiding a follower to blazing punishment, while 22:24 repeats passive guidance and supplies two contrary destinations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated h-d-y plus ila frame and opposite endpoints; I infer that routing is the shared function and destination supplies its valence. A live alternative is that 22:4 is punitive irony rather than evidence for a directionally neutral core.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is intrinsically beneficent, so the destinations merely restate what guidance already guarantees.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is morally contested routing, and 22:24 stages a decisive rerouting away from destructive patronage into wholesome speech and the Praiseworthy's way.

context_deltas.mechanism: Entry, adornment, and clothing are complete before the doubled guidance is named. The focus therefore adds a post-entry formation of voice and bearing: paradise is inhabited through learned wholesome relation and calm movement, not exhausted by location and possessions.

activation_trace.role: Passage into an interior establishes that admission precedes the focus guidance.
Adornment supplies an already transformed outward presentation before speech and path are taught.
Covering with clothing completes the material outfitting that the focus then exceeds.
Calmness and good bearing turn the doubled guidance into cultivated comportment after entry.
Voiced speech supplies the relational practice added to material adornment.
A straight road supplies ongoing bearing within the entered place.

structural_cues: 22:23 orders entry, flowing gardens, jewelry, and silk immediately before 22:24's two passive guidances.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies narrative order; I infer a progression from external placement and adornment to verbal and dispositional cultivation. A live alternative is that the clauses list simultaneous gifts without a temporal or pedagogical sequence.

changed_reading.before: Admission and adornment complete the reward, with 22:24 adding decorative praise.
changed_reading.after: Even after admission, recipients are cultivated into a fitting voice and gait; paradisal reward includes learned social and ethical inhabitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pilgrimage block joins a destination-oriented journey through distant passes, voiced remembrance, circling movement, rejection of counterfeit speech, and thanksgiving for guidance. The focus pair condenses this ritual technology: speech is purified while bodies are directed along a praising itinerary.

activation_trace.role: Intentional travel toward what is revered supplies the itinerary's orienting purpose.
A broad pass opened between mountains gives the path concrete long-distance terrain.
Remembrance running on the tongue makes correct utterance an action within the route.
Circling around a center converts orientation into repeated bodily movement.
Saying what was not so supplies the counterfeit verbal pole that wholesome speech excludes.
Falsehood and fabrication specify the distortion from which ritual speech must turn aside.
Guidance toward truth becomes the stated ground for magnifying God at the itinerary's sacrificial culmination.
The focus utterance gathers voiced remembrance and the exclusion of false saying into one positive destination.
The focus road gathers distant approach and repeated circling into a coherent praising course.

structural_cues: 22:27-30 orders arrival through deep passes, remembrance of God's name, completion of rites, circumambulation, and avoidance of false speech.
22:37 closes the sacrifice sequence by making prior guidance the reason for magnifying God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered verbal and bodily rites; I infer that the focus's speech-path pair is a compressed ritual mechanism rather than two unrelated rewards. A live alternative is that the pilgrimage sequence only analogically echoes an exclusively eschatological focus scene.

changed_reading.before: The good saying and praised path are abstract or exclusively celestial objects.
changed_reading.after: They form an enactable liturgy: truthful remembrance disciplines the mouth while directed and circular movement disciplines the body.

context_deltas.mechanism: A single confession causes expulsion from homes; migration on God's way then ends, even through death, in an entrance the displaced approve. The focus's good word is thus costly public allegiance, and the Praiseworthy's path is a reparative relocation that restores belonging.

activation_trace.role: Forced passage outside a place supplies the loss of home caused by the confession.
The voiced declaration 'our Lord is God' makes speech the explicit cause of displacement.
Movement from one dwelling to another carries the expelled confession into a migration.
An extended traversable way gives that migration its Godward course.
The paired verb and place of entry reverse expulsion into secure re-admission.
Satisfaction rather than resentment marks the affective completion of resettlement.
A soul made willing and pleased links good speech to the later satisfying entrance.
The straight road becomes the displacement-to-rehousing trajectory.
The praiseworthy final reach gives forced migration a repaired endpoint.

structural_cues: 22:40 says the displaced were expelled only for saying 'our Lord is God'; 22:58-59 follows migration, death, provision, and an entrance they find satisfying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the costly utterance and the later migration-to-entry arc; I infer that the focus joins them as speech whose path repairs dispossession. A live alternative is that 22:40 and 22:58-59 describe separate collectives and should not be narratively fused.

changed_reading.before: Good speech is pleasant language received after safety has already been secured.
changed_reading.after: The good word can be a dangerous confession that costs a home, while the Praiseworthy's path carries its speakers into restorative belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel through ruined terrain is made causally productive of reasoning hearts and compliant hearing. A path is therefore an organ of discernment: moving through material signs teaches how to receive speech, so wholesome saying and straight travel form a feedback loop.

activation_trace.role: Going and flowing through the land supplies the embodied inquiry that changes perception.
Reason that restrains ignorance names the heart's gain from travel.
Hearing as understanding and compliance converts encountered speech into responsive knowledge.
The repeated blindness root, explicitly relocated from eyes to hearts, supplies the failure that pedagogical travel remedies.
Voiced speech becomes something the trained ear and heart must genuinely receive.
The straight road becomes a method for producing discernment, not merely a line to a destination.

structural_cues: 22:45 presents collapsed settlements, abandoned wells, and raised palaces; 22:46 immediately asks whether travel through the land might produce reasoning hearts and hearing ears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ruin-to-travel-to-discernment sequence; I infer that the focus path can pedagogically condition reception of the focus speech. A live alternative is that 22:46 is an admonitory journey with no direct bearing on the eschatological sirat.

changed_reading.before: Speech gives information and a path merely carries an already informed traveler.
changed_reading.after: Walking among signs trains the heart to hear, so path and wholesome speech recursively make one another effective.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prophetic recitation is exposed to an alien casting, then the intrusion is removed and the signs made firm; knowledgeable hearers recognize truth, believe, humble their hearts, and are guided to a straight path. Al-tayyib min al-qawl can thus name speech after discrimination and repair, whose authenticated remainder generates guidance.

activation_trace.role: Recitation read and placed in its positions supplies the verbal medium into which interference enters.
Casting something down supplies the intrusive addition that makes verbal purification necessary.
Removal followed by replacement supplies the subtractive repair stage.
Firmness, precision, and secure construction supply the positive stabilization after removal.
Stable correspondence to reality names what knowledgeable recipients recognize in the repaired signs.
A low, quiet, spacious ground supplies the heart's receptive settling after recognition.
Gentle direction makes repaired and accepted discourse issue in guidance.
The explicit straight road reproduces the focus destination at the end of the processing chain.
Cleansing away contaminant supplies a cross-domain model for the speech made sound after removal.
Articulated discourse is the focus object re-read as the output of filtering and firming.

structural_cues: 22:52 orders recitation, satanic casting, removal, and firming; 22:53-54 then separates diseased or hard hearts from knowledgeable hearers whose hearts settle and who are guided to a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a verbal contamination-removal-firming-recognition chain; I map that chain onto min al-qawl as a selected or purified verbal remainder. A live alternative is that al-tayyib denotes praise or greeting without encoding any textual filtering process.

changed_reading.before: Wholesome speech is a ready-made, uncontested object to which recipients are pointed.
changed_reading.after: Wholesome speech can be the discerned remainder of contested discourse after intrusion is removed and meaning is secured; that repaired speech then opens the straight path.

context_deltas.mechanism: Subtle beneficence greens the earth, the self-sufficient One is explicitly al-Hamid, and traversability is maintained by a running ship and a sky held back from collapse. The path of al-Hamid becomes an experienced support-system whose praiseworthiness is discovered in safe passage rather than supplied by travelers' praise.

activation_trace.role: Gentleness and beneficence name the subtle care by which dead-looking terrain becomes traversably alive.
Self-sufficiency prevents divine praiseworthiness from depending on the traveler's acclaim.
Being found praiseworthy after experience turns al-Hamid from an abstract title into a tested verdict.
The vessel moving in water supplies a concrete traveler carried through an otherwise unstable medium.
Flowing movement makes beneficent order dynamically traversable.
Holding and restraining the sky supplies the hidden maintenance that prevents passage from collapsing.
Tender compassion identifies the motive as care for people rather than mechanical control.
Gentle direction resonates with the later subtle beneficence that makes the route usable.
The focus road becomes the experienced line through a maintained world.
The one found praiseworthy after trial makes praise the traveler's discovery along the road.

structural_cues: 22:63-65 moves from rain and green earth to al-Ghani al-Hamid, then to a ship running at command, a restrained sky, and compassion toward people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies environmental renewal, the paired divine epithets, and protected movement; I infer that these are encountered evidence defining the path's praiseworthy owner. A live alternative is that the cosmic signs ground praise without specifying the focus sirat.

changed_reading.before: Al-Hamid is only a fixed honorific attached to the road.
changed_reading.after: Travel itself discloses why the self-sufficient owner of the road is praiseworthy: subtle care keeps earth fertile, vessels moving, and the sky from falling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Distinct communal rites need not become verbal combat. The sequence forbids contention, preserves invitation, answers argument with a bounded statement of epistemic humility, and defers final judgment to God. Good speech is therefore a conflict-governing procedure that keeps people on straight guidance without pretending to erase difference.

activation_trace.role: Worship and approach to God ground the distinct rites over which communities might contend.
Mutual pulling between two sides supplies the conflict that speech must contain.
Calling and inclining by speech preserves invitation as the constructive alternative to contest.
Direction and manner make straight guidance a posture maintained during disagreement.
Twisted, entangling contention names the verbal escalation answered by a concise saying.
Speech used to negotiate an affair supplies a procedural reading of the commanded reply.
Judgment between people relocates final adjudication away from the disputants.
Each party taking a different way preserves real difference rather than dissolving it rhetorically.
The focus good speech becomes a disciplined way of negotiating contested affairs.
The straight road is maintained by bounded speech despite divergent communal ways.

structural_cues: 22:67-69 moves from distinct rites to 'do not let them dispute with you,' then to invitation, a prescribed reply if they argue, and God's later judgment over differences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the conflict-management sequence; I infer that it instantiates al-tayyib min al-qawl as procedural restraint. A live alternative is that the reply is a messenger-specific tactic rather than a general property of wholesome speech.

changed_reading.before: Good speech wins disagreement by stating the correct proposition more forcefully.
changed_reading.after: Good speech limits escalation, invites without coercion, acknowledges epistemic bounds, and leaves final judgment to God while straight guidance continues.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing commission joins selection, absence of constriction, Abraham's inherited milla, a conferred public name, reciprocal witnessing, and protective holding fast. The path of al-Hamid becomes a historically worn and publicly accountable vocation, not only a future road.

activation_trace.role: Selection and drawing near identify the community entrusted with the route.
Constriction supplies the explicitly negated condition, keeping the inherited way traversable.
A road made recognizable by repeated use turns inherited creed into a well-marked communal way.
Naming as public designation gives travelers a declared identity tied to the way.
Testimony grounded in knowledge turns the path into reciprocal public accountability.
Holding that prevents and preserves supplies the practice by which the community remains on the inherited way.
Direction, manner, and intent let the focus guidance extend into a historical communal vocation.
The straight road receives the closing image of a way worn clear by inherited practice.

structural_cues: 22:78 closes the surah with divine selection, no constriction in religion, Abraham's milla, the naming of Muslims, mutual witness, prayer, alms, and holding fast to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inherited creed, public naming, witness, and preservation; I infer that these temporal and social practices instantiate the focus sirat. A live alternative is that the ending lists obligations downstream from guidance without redefining the focus road.

changed_reading.before: The Praiseworthy's path is an individual and exclusively eschatological route.
changed_reading.after: It is also an inherited, well-marked, non-constricting public vocation sustained by named identity, witness, repeated practice, and protective attachment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because hudu is a passive verb of guidance, not the noun for a sanctuary offering. It remains worth carrying because the focus inventory itself preserves gift and sacrificial-offering branches, while the surah's pilgrimage sequence names intentional approach, offered bodies, what reaches God, and guidance. Render only as a ritual echo in which the guided are ceremonially ushered or presented, never as the lexical translation of hudu.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled h-d-y form can activate both a gift sent toward one loved and an offering conducted toward the sanctuary.

activation_trace.role: A gently dispatched gift to one loved supplies the image of recipients being welcomed and presented.
An offering conveyed toward the sanctuary supplies the ritual directionality behind the presentation.
Intentional approach to the revered gives the offering echo a destination.
The explicitly offered sacrificial body supplies the sequence's material presentation.
Causing something to reach another distinguishes material that does not reach God from piety that does.
The sanctuary-offering branch makes guidance at the rite's close resonate with directed presentation.

changed_reading.before: The recipients are simply shown where to go.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory ritual register, they are ceremonially ushered as welcomed offerings, with wholesome speech functioning as a nonmaterial presentation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant h-d-d mapping for focus h-d-y. It remains anchored through that supplied focus branch and through 22:40's explicit demolition threat against worship places following a protected confession. Render as an acoustic and branch-level anti-demolition resonance, not as a claim that hudu means rebuilding or demolition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The non-dominant focus mapping activates severe breaking and demolition beside the verse's good saying and Praiseworthy path.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking and demolition supply the form-distant danger against which the doubled guidance can resonate.
Voiced speech keeps the resonance anchored in the focus's verbal destination.
The spoken confession supplies the vulnerable word whose public habitats require protection.
Pushing away harm supplies the social counterforce that prevents destruction.
A building brought down makes the demolition resonance explicit in the surah.
Divine remembrance running on tongues identifies what protected worship spaces allow to continue.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns only private refinement after salvation.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root-split resonance, its good speech and praising way also answer the threatened demolition of the communal spaces where confession and remembrance can live.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because sirat ordinarily denotes a road, while the cited branch images swallowing and disappearance in passage. It remains valid as a cross-domain activation because the branch is supplied for the focus root and the ritual context places voiced remembrance beside eating and feeding. Render as an embodiment metaphor in which speech is taken in and shared, never as the lexical gloss of sirat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The swallowing branch of s-r-t sits beside inward qawl and the wholesome quality of what is received.

activation_trace.role: Swallowing and disappearance through passage turn the road into an exploratory image of internalization.
Speech held inward before voicing supplies the verbal content that can be taken into the self.
Wholesome and lawful quality makes the internalized verbal material fit for incorporation.
Remembrance running on the tongue places voiced sacred speech beside consumption.
Taking in food supplies the material analogue for inward appropriation.
Feeding another turns internalized good into something redistributed rather than privately retained.

changed_reading.before: Wholesome speech is uttered alongside an independently traveled road.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, wholesome speech is taken in until it becomes a traversed disposition, then externalized and shared like nourishment.

strongest_changes: The punitive h-d-y plus ila construction in 22:4 makes the focus a moral rerouting rather than a redundant description of intrinsically good guidance.
The pilgrimage sequence fuses truthful remembrance, rejection of false speech, and directed bodily movement into an enacted speech-path mechanism.
The expulsion-migration-entry arc makes the good word a costly confession and the path a reparative resettlement.
The recitation-casting-removal-firming chain makes wholesome speech a discerned and repaired verbal remainder that can generate straight guidance.
The dispute sequence makes good speech a non-escalatory procedure that preserves invitation and defers final judgment without erasing difference.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made the focus a hinge joining verbal purification to movement across distinct domains: post-entry cultivation, pilgrimage, displacement, historical learning, revelation repair, cosmic support, conflict practice, and inherited public vocation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether min al-qawl supports a genuinely partitive filtered remainder or simply classifies the speech as wholesome.
How strongly the narrative order of entry, adornment, and guidance licenses a post-entry pedagogical sequence.
Whether al-Hamid primarily names the route's divine owner, its goal, or the praiseworthy quality encountered along it.
The offering, non-dominant h-d-d, and swallowing activations should remain analogical branch echoes rather than lexical claims.
